reuse.why: No existing helper covered this rule; the change adds one guard and applies it to every existing link handler through a small wrapper, reusing the AccountSyncSource type and LinkAccountBaseParams.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in assertBankAccountNotLinked; the five registrations only differ in provider and how the account id is read.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/app.ts beside the handlers; applying it at app.method registration keeps handler bodies untouched, though it separates the rule from the handlers a reader would look at first.

scope.why: Only the guard, the handler registrations and tests for the requested behaviours.

maintainability.why: Clear single rule with good tests; a future provider handler must remember to be registered through withBankAccountLinkGuard, and the AccountHandlers type still names the unwrapped functions.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts, applied to all five provider link handlers via withBankAccountLinkGuard at registration
